tiles.name: Daily Active Players, Fights & Fun Rate (30d)
tiles.description: Top-line prod DAU, fight_ended count, decided win rate, abandon rate, and thumbs-up enjoyment rate.
tiles.hogql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS day,
  uniqExact(distinct_id) AS dau,
  count() AS fights,
  round(countIf(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived')) / nullIf(countIf(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived', 'lost')), 0) * 100, 1) AS win_pct,
  round(countIf(properties.outcome = 'left') / count() * 100, 1) AS abandon_pct,
  round(countIf(properties.fun_rating = 'up') / nullIf(countIf(properties.fun_rating IN ('up', 'down')), 0) * 100, 1) AS fun_pct
FROM events
WHERE event = 'fight_ended'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.env), '') = 'prod'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC

tiles.name: Install Cohort D1 / D3 / D7 / D14 Retention
tiles.description: Classic day-offset prod retention grouped by each player’s first_seen_date person property.
tiles.hogql:
SELECT
  toDate(person.properties.first_seen_date) AS cohort_date,
  uniqExact(distinct_id) AS cohort_size,
  round(uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toIntOrZero(toString(properties.days_since_install)) = 1) / nullIf(uniqExact(distinct_id), 0) * 100, 1) AS d1_pct,
  round(uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toIntOrZero(toString(properties.days_since_install)) = 3) / nullIf(uniqExact(distinct_id), 0) * 100, 1) AS d3_pct,
  round(uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toIntOrZero(toString(properties.days_since_install)) = 7) / nullIf(uniqExact(distinct_id), 0) * 100, 1) AS d7_pct,
  round(uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toIntOrZero(toString(properties.days_since_install)) = 14) / nullIf(uniqExact(distinct_id), 0) * 100, 1) AS d14_pct
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('app_opened', 'fight_ended')
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.env), '') = 'prod'
  AND person.properties.first_seen_date IS NOT NULL
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 45 DAY
GROUP BY cohort_date
ORDER BY cohort_date DESC

tiles.name: Adventure Campaign Progression Funnel (v0.1.166+)
tiles.description: Prod players reached vs cleared, win rate, abandon rate, and enjoyment per campaign level since E9 (v0.1.166+).
tiles.hogql:
SELECT
  toIntOrZero(toString(properties.level_order)) AS level_order,
  toString(properties.level_id) AS level_id,
  any(toString(properties.level_name)) AS level_name,
  uniqExact(distinct_id) AS players_reached,
  uniqExactIf(distinct_id, properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived')) AS players_cleared,
  count() AS attempts,
  round(countIf(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived')) / nullIf(countIf(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived', 'lost')), 0) * 100, 1) AS win_pct,
  round(countIf(properties.outcome = 'left') / count() * 100, 1) AS abandon_pct,
  round(countIf(properties.fun_rating = 'up') / nullIf(countIf(properties.fun_rating IN ('up', 'down')), 0) * 100, 1) AS fun_pct
FROM events
WHERE event = 'fight_ended'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.env), '') = 'prod'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.mode), 'adventure') = 'adventure'
  AND lower(coalesce(toString(properties.practice), 'false')) NOT IN ('true', '1')
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.outcome), '') != 'practice'
  AND NOT has(JSONExtractArrayRaw(coalesce(toString(properties.fun_tags), '[]')), '"bug_in_game"')
  AND (toInt64OrZero(arrayElement(splitByChar('.', replaceRegexpOne(coalesce(toString(properties.app_version), '0.0.0'), '^v', '')), 1)) * 1000000 + toInt64OrZero(arrayElement(splitByChar('.', replaceRegexpOne(coalesce(toString(properties.app_version), '0.0.0'), '^v', '')), 2)) * 1000 + toInt64OrZero(arrayElement(splitByChar('.', replaceRegexpOne(coalesce(toString(properties.app_version), '0.0.0'), '^v', '')), 3))) >= 1166
GROUP BY level_order, level_id
ORDER BY level_order ASC, level_id ASC

tiles.name: Weapon Balance · Level-Adjusted Win Delta & Fun (v0.1.166+)
tiles.description: Adventure prod balance (v0.1.166+, >=3 sets, >=10s, non-practice, non-tutorial, <=50% coached) controlling for each level’s baseline win rate.
tiles.hogql:
WITH level_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    toString(properties.level_id) AS lvl,
    countIf(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived')) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS lvl_win_rate,
    avgIf(log(greatest(toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.dpm)), 1)), toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.dpm)) > 0) AS lvl_log_dpm
  FROM events
  WHERE event = 'fight_ended'
  AND (toInt64OrZero(arrayElement(splitByChar('.', replaceRegexpOne(coalesce(toString(properties.app_version), '0.0.0'), '^v', '')), 1)) * 1000000 + toInt64OrZero(arrayElement(splitByChar('.', replaceRegexpOne(coalesce(toString(properties.app_version), '0.0.0'), '^v', '')), 2)) * 1000 + toInt64OrZero(arrayElement(splitByChar('.', replaceRegexpOne(coalesce(toString(properties.app_version), '0.0.0'), '^v', '')), 3))) >= 1166
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.env), '') = 'prod'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.mode), 'adventure') = 'adventure'
  AND lower(coalesce(toString(properties.practice), 'false')) NOT IN ('true', '1')
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.outcome), '') != 'practice'
  AND NOT has(JSONExtractArrayRaw(coalesce(toString(properties.fun_tags), '[]')), '"bug_in_game"')
  AND toIntOrZero(toString(properties.sets)) >= 3
  AND toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.duration_ms)) >= 10000
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.level_id), '') != '1-1'
  AND (toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.helped_sets)) / greatest(toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.sets)), 1)) <= 0.5
  AND properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived', 'lost')
  GROUP BY lvl
)
SELECT
  trim(BOTH '"' FROM raw_weapon_id) AS weapon_id,
  count() AS fights_held,
  uniqExact(distinct_id) AS players,
  round(countIf(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived')) / nullIf(count(), 0) * 100, 1) AS raw_win_pct,
  round(avg(if(properties.outcome IN ('won', 'survived'), 1.0, 0.0) - lb.lvl_win_rate) * 100, 1) AS adj_win_delta_pct,
  round(avgIf(log(greatest(toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.dpm)), 1)) - lb.lvl_log_dpm, toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.dpm)) > 0), 3) AS adj_log_dpm_delta,
  round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(toString(properties.dpm))), 0) AS avg_dpm,
  round(countIf(properties.fun_rating = 'up') / nullIf(countIf(properties.fun_rating IN ('up', 'down')), 0) * 100, 1) AS fun_pct
FROM events
LEFT JOIN level_baselines lb ON toString(properties.level_id) = lb.lvl

  AND lower(coalesce(toString(properties.practice), 'false')) NOT IN ('true', '1')
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
